name.value: Coast Prince George Hotel by APA

description.value: Coast Prince George Hotel by APA is a full-service urban-style hotel in the heart of downtown Prince George, Northern BC's largest city. It incorporates APA Hotel elements from Japan — including TOTO Washlet bathrooms and origami crane décor — alongside on-site dining at Shogun Japanese Steakhouse and Winston's Resto-Bar. The hotel also offers an indoor pool, hot tub, and sauna, making it a comfortable base for cyclists tackling long routes through the Central Interior.
